system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Auspex, Intermediate Dementation. For some, madness is a link to the storms of destiny. By opening her mind to the inherent lunacy of the world and observing the mind-shattering patterns of fate (usually through devices like thrown bones, billows of smoke, entrails, or tides), the Malkavian seer can predict the future, bombarded by images or gaining instinctual feelings.

System: The player phrases a question or subject for the divination, then spends two blood points and rolls Perception + Awareness (difficulty 8); the process takes about an hour. For simple information, a single success indicates a quick flash accompanied by a dominant emotion, while five successes indicate a true experience set in the future. If applied to an action the character is about to undertake, successes may instead be banked as a pool and spent to reduce the difficulty of subsequent rolls tied to that action (each success spent once). Prophecy can be used on others' fates for the same blood cost, at up to +2 difficulty, and can be relayed to the subject (which requires a further roll to convey, Storyteller's discretion).

Costs 20 Experience Traits to learn.

MET: Spend two Blood Traits and win a Static Mental Challenge (retest Awareness) after an hour of divination; on success the Storyteller provides a true glimpse of probable fate relevant to the question asked, or grants the character a pool of retest Traits usable on rolls tied to the divined action.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
